item.description:
IPTVMac 0.25.40
- Show one poster for regional copies of the same movie or series, keeping different release years separate. Watch still offers the available provider categories. - Open Continue Watching directly in the player, resuming ten seconds before the saved position. Series continue with the last observed episode. - Improve video frame pacing and reduce repeated audio/subtitle menu work for titles with many tracks. - Protect saved progress during startup, seeking and player handoffs.
For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. This development-signed build is not notarized; macOS may require its normal launch approval.
